slides.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished landscape 3:2 infographic explanation slide for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese beginner optometry AI Agent workshop. Cream background, dark navy crisp sans-serif type, blue/teal/amber panels, restrained friendly student-at-laptop illustration. This is a conceptual teaching slide, not a screenshot.
Exact heading "視光實作 ① 短版". Subtitle "先把轉換規則說清楚".
Three large panels left to right connected with arrows:
"輸入" showing "S = -2.00 D", "C = -1.00 D", "A = 180°".
"轉換" with "S′ = S + C", "C′ = −C", "A′ = A + 90°". Under it "大於 180° 才減 180°".
"結果" showing "-3.00 D / +1.00 D × 90°".
A large bottom comparison box "邊界核對" with "90° → 180°" and "91° → 1°".
Footer exact "先手算，再操作；只用虛構課堂數值。".
Make accurate standard Chinese glyphs, mathematical primes/subscripts clear. No eye anatomy, no clinical or lens suggestions. No extra text, no shop imagery. Large typography with generous spacing.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished landscape 3:2 conceptual infographic explanation slide for a beginner medical laboratory AI Agent workshop in Taiwan. Cream background, navy large crisp sans-serif Traditional Chinese typography, blue/teal/amber cards with arrows, friendly small student-at-laptop drawing. NOT a physical experiment procedure, NOT a fabricated screenshot.
Exact heading "醫檢實作 ① 短版". Subtitle "先分清楚最終體積與稀釋液體積".
Panel 1 "輸入": "C₁ = 10 mg/mL", "C₂ = 2 mg/mL", "V₂ = 25 mL".
Panel 2 "計算": "C₁V₁ = C₂V₂", "V₁ = (C₂ × V₂) ÷ C₁", "稀釋液 = V₂ − V₁".
Panel 3 "結果": "原液 5 mL", "稀釋液 20 mL".
Bottom conceptual horizontal volume bar two colored segments labelled "5 mL" and "20 mL", complete bar labelled "最終體積 25 mL". No vessels, pipettes or operational laboratory directions.
Footer "先手算，再操作；只用虛構課堂數值。".
Every 稀 must be 禾+希, 體積 complete correctly formed. No extra text or claims.

Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape 3:2 conceptual infographic slide for Taiwan beginner optometry AI Agent workshop. Cream/navy, blue/teal/amber panels, crisp printed Traditional Chinese, friendly laptop student. Heading "視光實作 ② 完整版". Subtitle "把範圍、顯示與驗收寫進需求".
Three panels:
"先檢查" with "−20 ≤ S ≤ 20 D", "−20 ≤ C < 0 D", "1 ≤ A ≤ 180，整數". Red small invalid symbols next to "空白" "非數字" "超出範圍".
"再計算" with "S′ = S + C", "C′ = −C", "A′ = A + 90°", "大於 180° 才減 180°".
"核對輸出" with a generic schematic output card labelled "度數兩位小數", "柱面帶正號", "軸度整數". Show exact example "-0.50 D / +0.75 D × 180°".
Bottom four small check icons with exact labels "離線開啟" "Tab / Enter" "手機可讀" "手算一致".
Footer "只用虛構課堂數值，不作為臨床依據。".
No additional captions, no clinical imagery, no invented UI screenshots. All text large and correctly formed.

Use case: scientific-educational. Landscape 3:2 conceptual infographic slide for Taiwan beginner medical laboratory AI Agent workshop. Cream/navy, blue/teal/amber panels, crisp accurate Traditional Chinese type, friendly laptop student. Exact heading "醫檢實作 ② 完整版". Subtitle "把單位、範圍與精度寫進需求".
Three connected panels:
"共同單位" with "C₁、C₂：同一濃度單位", "V₁、V₂、稀釋液：同一體積單位", small option pills "mg/mL" "µg/mL" "%（w/v）" and "mL" "µL". Emphasized "不自動換算".
"先檢查" with "C₁ > 0", "V₂ > 0", "0 < C₂ ≤ C₁". Emphasized "C₂ > C₁：提醒，不計算".
"核對輸出" with "C₂ = C₁ → 不需稀釋", and "原液 10.000 mL", "稀釋液 0.000 mL". small label "僅顯示時取三位小數".
Footer "三位小數是本題顯示規格；只用虛構課堂數值。".
No physical experiment instructions, no claims about laboratory equipment precision, no fabricated screenshot, no additional text. High legibility with correct 稀 and 積 glyphs.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create landscape 3:2 explanation slide for Taiwan beginner optometry AI Agent workshop, cream background, navy Traditional Chinese printed text, blue/teal/amber accents, friendly small student with laptop. Exact heading "視光實作 ③ 改進版". Subtitle "保留算法，讓核對更容易".
Four illustrated feature cards: "五組範例" with five numbered buttons 1 2 3 4 5; "清除" with reset icon; "欄位旁提醒" with a red message immediately beneath a generic input; "圖解核對" with a worksheet lens-axis diagram, not eye anatomy.
Central short operating flow "載入範例 → 按轉換 → 對照手算".
Bottom two boundary cards "90° → 180°" and "91° → 1°", show green checks.
Footer "短版、完整版、改進版，各自保留。".
Large accurate Chinese glyphs. No new clinical interpretation, no fabricated screenshot, no extra text, no graphical 0 degree output.
